notes.title: Overdungeon just got its first update in 4 years as developer blames issues with publishing contract
notes.notes:
I have a soft spot for Overdungeon, a maximalist real-time mashup of tower defense and collectible card game, and I sang its praises three years ago. Its developers, Pocketpair, haven't updated it since, instead pouring their work into similarly expansive "everything game" Craftopia and the Pokémon-alike (but with guns) Palworld.

Now Pocketpair have released a content update for Overdungeon and say that previous radio silence was because they were "a bit tired and struggled with our contract with the publisher."

notes.title: Why The Overdungeon's Update Took 4 Years To Come Alive
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here comes the free update of Overdungeon!

This update has fixed many bugs and added a new character! Check this release note for more information!

Well, here is a brief explanation of why the development of Overdungeon has been halted. Overdungeon is the first game Pocketpair introduced to the world and is the one we've poured our efforts into.
Development of the game started when Takuro Mizobe, the CEO of Pocketpair, wondered what would happen if we combined two of his favorite games "Slay the Spire" and "Clash Royale"?

After its release, we have been working crazily to release patches daily to make our favorite game a finished product. We signed a contract with a publisher to that more players could enjoy our game, but it didn't work out well as opposed to our expectations, and we needed to figure out what to do.

At some point, we gave up on updating Overdungeon. We couldn't make a living with that.

Instead, we decided to start developing "Craftopia".

It really was painful for us to start the development of Craftopia while Overdungeon still had bugs. And we've always wanted to update the game. However, after hard work, we were a bit tired and struggled with our contract with the publisher to put our hands on updates.

Now, Pocketpair has all the rights to Overdungeon again, and we have become a bit larger as an organization. So we are finally ready to resume the updates of Overdungeon!
Overdungeon is a challenging game with rough edges, slightly strange game balance, and full of our souls and passions!

Pocketpair loves and develops all of our games. We'd love to keep working on previously released games like Overdungeon to reflect players' feedback as much as possible.

Thank you for your continued support!

★ Warm Fuzzy Yarn Ball

Summon: the initial number of Sheep changed from 2 to 3

Attack: damage of Fireball changed from 10 to 5
They had been so strong as the Bosses. That was not the thing we intended to create.

Attack: damage increased by 2

He got the body of immortality.

Attack: damage of Lightning decreased by 1, the number of Lightning increased by 1

★ A Mischief of Mice

★ Incubator
Health: changed from 1500 to 2000

★ Shaman
Summon: the number of Goat is decreased

Their behavior has been reworked; they'll throw more Barrels from this patch. They successfully defeated the players and they had the highest win rate of the enemies'; however, the players with well-built decks could often slay Hunting Party without receiving any damages.
We decreased the frequency of Extra Animal buff and increased the frequency of Dog Barrels. Enjoy the hunting!

 Adjustment: Ally leader 
Sugar is obviously a tricky leader to play. Expert players are the only ones to play her in most cases; therefore, she has been the least played leader and the win rate of hers has been tending to be higher than others. Despite this fact, the win rates of Lilith and Valley have been lowered by updates and updates. In order to balance those leaders, we decided to strengthen her and him.

★ Blood Potion
Effect: the amount of HP restored is doubled
There hasn't been a massive difference between the win rates of Lilith and Sugar in Normal or easier dungeons, but the gap has been wider in Season Dungeon. This change won't likely affect tremendously when you have much healths. We think it'll help you a lot in Season Dungeon and balance them out.

★ Raise Your Weapon
Effect: changed to """"At the end of each turn, apply 2 Swords to the nearest Animal to your leader. Exhaust/---""""
Valley has been the leader with the lowest win rate for a while. And the cards with AoE effect are quite hard to play. The pre-reworked effect of this card has been not suitable for the initial deck of his. Based on reflection on the past, we reformed this card as one of the snowballing cards such as Lilith's Mortar and Sugar's Execution Button.

 Adjustment: Cards 
We decided to buff the cards with 20% or less pick rate. Those are the cards to be buffed in this patch.

★ Ruins Rebirth
Effect: changed to """"Overload 1/2; Shuffle your draw pile into your discard pile. Deal 10/20 damage for each card in your discard pile.""""
This card had the lowest pick rate. The effect becomes simple and easily understandable one; the expected amount of damage is increased as well.

★ Burnout
★ Goat
Attack: damage is doubled, so they can slay Chicks in one shot
Health: HP is doubled, so they can survive an attack of Bear
These 2 cards had the second and the third lowest pick rate. We assumed it was because Goat was not a reliable animal in the dungeon.

Effect: changed to ""Deal 30 damage to a random enemy animal or a random enemy leader for 4/6 times.""

Summon: the number of rabbits changed from 1/4 to 2/4

★ Headhunting Rabbit

We investigated this situation by taking a survey(sample size: 1). As a result, 100% of players in the sample love Chicken Egg. notes.title: Patch No.135 Update v1.1.146
notes.notes:
Hi, there! Long time no see!
We finally update Overdungeon for the first time in a month! Are you excited? We are surely excited; our hearts are pounding now!

You all are probably wondering what we did in the past 1 month. We were just procrast... working really hard on Overdungeon to develop new contents eagerly. Today's release note is as long as the short novel. To read, or not to read, that is the question.

Of course we sincerely want to release the update more frequently, however, Overdungeon has become unexpectedly, uncontrollably huge game at the bullet-train pace! Daily updates... we can't do that anymore. Yet, we are sitting on a chair, facing against the monitors, and developing Overdungeon every day as if we'd still keep going with the crazy updating cycles! There's no need to worry. Updates are planned to be delivered on a monthly basis!

====================================
Erm, we have a quite big news today.
Overdungeon. will. be. associated. with, Leiting Games.

Those who don't know its name, those who like video-games, should read this web
https://www.leiting.com/ 

Leiting Games is a famous publishing company in China especially in the field of Roguelike games. That's why they asked Overdungeon, the famous Realtime Roguelike Tower Defence Cardgame, to associate with!

Anyway, we're going to keep working on it. Thank you in advance for all of your support!

====================================

Huh, today's release note contains so many things, so here is the handy one.
 Summary 
★ New Boss ""Magus""!
★ Map UI is drastically changed!
★ The new system ""Enchantment"" is available! ""Generous Strike"", ""Self-assertive Think Twice""...? Feel the possibilities!
★ All of the events are revised to make the gameplay more enjoyable!
★ 20 awesome relics are added!
★ The new mode ""Auto Mode"" can be activated! Overdungeon is also the most impressive card simulator! (Did you know that?)

====================================
For furthermore information, please check below! Enjoy ;)



 New Contents 
★ The Magus is now available as the boss in Stage 1. The special visual effects will be played when you enter the combat against him. Enjoy it ;)
★ Valley's Recall has 2 new Epic cards, ""Limit Breaks"" and ""Omnisword""! There's no limit above us...!
★ Season Dungeon Lv9 and Lv10 are available now! You better strategize every move when you Season Dungeon Lv10!

 Bug Fixes 
★ Penguins used to come closer and stare at you and your animals. They will dive into you and explode on contact. Explosive Pain-guins...
★ The bug that the Swords attached to the Animals who assault attack deal damage twice is fixed.

 UI / UX Change 
★ UI / UX in the game are drastically changed! It's super-duper cool, isn't it?!
★ UI moves when you enter the combat.
★ Particles are added to the background of the combat screen.
★ The background of the combat screen in Stage 2 is changed. (We're working on Stage 3 one right now!)
★ Visual effects of Worms are improved.
★ The visual effect of the upgraded Fireball becomes bigger.
★ The size of the explosion effect of Fireball and Amplifire is adjusted.
★ Lilith's clothes are changed. They're not NSFW anymore.

 Balance Adjustment: Game Systems 
★ Bold Changes on Gold
• The prices of cards are multiplied by approximately 2.5. (This change affects the prices to buy cards and to sell cards as well!)
• The prices of relics are multiplied by approximately 3.
• Starting gold is increased by 200G.

Do you remember the days you've left more than 1000G when you defeated Omega, the Over?
This over-earning was caused by the prices of cards and relics. They had been too easy to grab at the shop; therefore, we changed the economy in the dungeon as we said above. Card Collect Service is not affected by this change.

★ A new Turn is Born.
• Before drawing cards at the start of your turn, you must wait until the enemy leaders finish their actions.
• The timing when the effects or cards and relics are applied is changed: ""at the start of your draw phase"" to ""at the end of your draw phase.""
• Slow Motion will be activated while you're holding a card in your turn.
• Once you play 30 or more cards, the turn starts moving even if it's the very first turn. This change is made to counter infinity loops. There has been the threshold, ""20 cards on the stack"", however, the cards such as Gallop can easily stack those amount of cards. That's why we made this change.

★ Animals Got My Back, No Assault Attack.
• Your large animals (Elephants, Bears, Lions) will not assault attack anymore.
• The attack range of assault attacks is changed to the attack range of Horses. Except for explosive animals (Sheep, Penguins).
• The damages of assault attacks are changed.
	☆ Horses: 40 to 20 damage. (Yours and enemies' both assault attack.)
	☆ Elephants: 30 to 20 damage. (Only enemies' assault attack.)
	☆ Bears: 50 to 30 damage. (Only enemies' assault attack.)
	☆ Lions: 50 to 30 damage. (Only enemies' assault attack.)

It's been a long time since they started dealing tons of damage by assault attacks. And due to its attack, your animals disappeared from the battlefield way too quickly than you expected.
This change might allow you to take a tank strategy. Large animals will tank damages while ranged animals dealing damage from the backside. Let's give it a try!

★ Swap the Map System
• UI / UX in the map screen is renewed.
• Each stage is separated into Former, Latter, and Boss; therefore, it becomes easier to plan which way to go.
• Now you can use Gold to take anoth... Launch the game now, see what is going on around the map!
• The numbers of Camp and Shop are controlled with Maximum and Minimum number now.

We've been received the reactions on the old map system. ""I want to see the whole map beforehand."" ""The whole map should be shown."" We believe this change will introduce you to the new gameplay while we keeping the game tempo.

★ Upgraded cards will sometimes appear in Stage 2 and Stage 3! This is the game changer. Card pick is so much fun!

★ Auto Mode is available now! If you activate Auto Mode, your leaders will fight by themselves! Let's try it out!

★ New feature ""Enchantment"" is available now. You can add a unique effect to your cards at the special rest site. For instance, when the enchantment ""Generous"" is applied to ""Strike"", it makes ""Generous Strike"". You can deal damage and gain ""Carrot"" next turn!

★ You can't play some cards under specific conditions anymore. Such as ""Counter"" is only playable when enemy leaders plan to attack.

 Balance Adjustment: Card Adjustment 
★ Assault Pony: Summon 1/2 Horse(s) → 2/4 Horse(s).
The damage of assault attack of Horse is halved, so the number of Horses is doubled. You can trigger Triplet Egg with the initial deck now.

★ Gallop: Summon 1 Horse for every 5/3 card(s) → 2/1 card(s).
It becomes a more useful card because upgraded Gallop will summon at least 1 Horse. This change severly affects the number of Horse(s) summoned by this card. Play together with Sword related cards!

★ Chick Party: Summon 10/20 Chick(s) → 20/30 Chick(s).
★ Egg Bomb: Summon 5/15 Chick(s) → 10/20 Chick(s).
★ Bear Trap: Set 1/2 Bear Trap(s) → 2/4 Bear Trap(s).
★ Blood of Tarmogorf: Added Anywhere. Summon 2/3 Dog(s) → 3/4 Dog(s) for every card type.
★ Patchy the Puppy: Added Anywhere.
★ Fireball: Deal 25/70 damage → 50/100 damage.
★ Awakening: Negative effect is changed → You can play this card if you have 5 or more card(s) in your discard pile.
★ Sly Bunny: Charm 1 nearest animal(s) → 2 nearest animal(s).
★ Dejavu: Added the bonus effect ""Draw that many +1/+2 card(s).""
Dejavu can now increase the number of cards in your hand like Loaded Dice.
★ Ruined Rebirth: Deal 1/10 extra damage → 10/20 extra damage for every card you shuffle into your draw pile.
★ Dual Craft, Dual Summon: Their effect will last till the next turn.
★ Salvage can be used to take Epic and Legendary cards back from your exhaust pile from this patch. You can salvage up to 1 card at once, however, upgraded Salvage doesn't have Exhaust anymore.
★ Makeup: Modified. (Draw 1 card.) Upgrade random 3 cards in your hand for the rest of the combat.

★ Dogs move 1.5 times faster.

 Balance Adjustment: Enemy Leaders Adjustment 
★ Enemy leaders' Max HP won't vary so much.
★ Hound Band: The number of Hound(s) is 3 → 2.
★ Dog Barrel: When the owner of Dog Barrel(s) is slain, Dog Barrel(s) in the air also gets destroyed.
★ Don Turtle: Nerfed. HP is decreased by 10%. Prickle(s) is decreased to 5. Its behavior is revised.
★ Worm: Split when they have 50% → 70% or less HP.
★ Hunting Party: Their HP is increased by 20%.
★ Monster House: Summon random animals when dealt damage → when dealt damage by attack card(s) or animal(s). Damage dealt by relic(s) and trap(s) won't trigger its effect.
★ Wonder Sheep: The number of Sheep hut which she places is halved. The number of Fireball she casts is increased by 1 instead.
★ World Saver: Heroine's HP is increased by 15%.
★ Death Knight: Prickle(s) is decreased to 5. Its attack is a little bit buffed.
★ Crawler: The number of attacks is 3~5 → 3~6.
★ Omega, the Over: His Max HP is doubled (he has 10000 HP now.)
He obviously has important roles to play in Overdungeon: he protects the gate of the dungeon; he becomes a punching bag for the players and the well-built, well-maintained, well-played decks. Make sure to bring your favorite deck with you! Enjoy!
★ Omega, the Over: His behavior is adjusted.

★ The effect of Confusion will not be applied to the cards generated during the combat.

 Balance Adjustment: Relics Adjustment 
★ Breeding Feed: Due to the change to Dual Summon, its effect is rewritten. (If you don't have the state of Dual Summon at the start of your turn, you gain the state of Dual Summon.)
★ Gold Ingot: Gain 300 Gold → 500 Gold.
★ Codex of Odd Pages: Has a chance to play a card again → A card you play has a chance to return back to your hand.
The previous effect of this relic is barely noticeable. When a card comes back to you, it gives you joy and surprise.
★ The effect of Storm Stone is changed to ""Every time you play 3 Spells in a single turn, draw 1 card."" An infinite loop will be starting from here!
★ The effect of Mithril Stump is changed from ""play this card one more time."" to ""this card returns back to your hand.""
★ Attack, Building, and Spell version of Mithril Stump is available now!
★ The rarity of Mushroom relics is changed to Rare. These relics are obviously strong but they often make you feel sad by appearing from a chest in middle-game. Overdungeon should be the game you enjoy challenging in the dungeon. Epic relics are ones of the things the players want to obtain, so they should entertain the players. Mushrooms are beautiful, elegant, superb, marvelous... however, the gameplay with Mushrooms before was not epic.
★ The rarity of Triplet Eggs is changed to Epic.
★ Legendary relics will appear more frequently. Its chance is increased by 60%.
★ New relics are added to the game! Each relic has a unique effect and quite a game-changer.
• Are Chickens giving births to Chicks? Who believes that in Overdungeon? Your Chicks become your Dogs. An epic relic, ""Origin of Species = Chick "", is on sale now!
• Have you ever satisfied with the amount of reward after combat? An epic relic, ""Gleaming Mirror"", will make a clone of the reward when you add it to your deck!
These relics are just the beginning; they aren't the end. 20 new relics are awaiting you in the dungeon! All of them are Epic or Legendary ones!

 Balance Adjustment: Events Adjustment 
★ Events will no longer have the story texts.
★ All of the events are revised.
★ 4 new events are added.


====================================

Thank you for reading it again!
......yes. You read the release note thoroughly; you attempted several times to find the words ""New Character"", ""New Card Pack"", or ""New...... something.""
Did we state that we'd provide you with new contents monthly...?

We're terribly sorry about that.

You might wanna say, ""You are the procrastinators!""
You might wanna say, ""You all are lacking the imagination!""
You might wanna say, ""This update is just a scam! You played us!""
None of them are true!!
We had the idea related to ""Sacrifice"", ""Alchemy"", ""Farming"", ""Bombs"", ""Necromancer"", ""Super robot"", and so on... Each idea is unique and has the great potential to be the new content! We were actually preparing for that!

On the other hand, this is the world where human forms the civilizations. Did you realize the change of Lilith's clothes? (shh... its update is made to be playable around the globe. I know you've been playing Overdungeon to see that clothes, though...)
There are a bunch of things to do, Endless Dungeon, PVP System, Adjustment on games...

We really want to release, absolutely want to make new card packs playable for you! But there always comes the priority. We have a thing to do at the moment, unfortunately.

Hmm? You did make 20 new relics so there should've been the time for new card packs...?

We created those relics just because we received the reply ""Overdungeon lacks strategies..."" and we were furious. There's no regret, though.

Anyway, it's hard to release new card pack for now.
Again we're sorry about that.
Please look forward to the enrichment of other contents.

Over!

notes.title: Patch No.108 Daily Update v1.1.87 (Consecutive 100 days! Guinness Challenge!)
notes.notes:
Thank you for visiting us again!
Today we have 2 things to tell you!

First, we finally release Valley into the dungeon! We're feeling really happy and glad to have this moment.
Valley is an experienced soldier who lost his memory. He crawls into the dungeon to fulfill the promise he made one day...!
We made so many Overdungeon-esque cards for his card pack. Try them out!

Second, today is the day we achieve Consecutive 100 Days Daily Update! Thanks to all of your support, we finally did it! Thank you so much!
The reason we started updating Overdungeon on a daily basis is there were so many bugs to fix when we released Overdungeon. As we continued updating every day, we started thinking:

"Hmm, we planned to update every Friday at first, but we are updating every day..." (Thanks to all of the comments pointing out "Every day is Friday!", "NO UPDATE TODAY FRAUD")
↓
"What if we'd release it every day 'cuz we develop every single day...?"
↓
"Overdungeon is the game updated every day!!!"

Then we decided to update Overdungeon on a daily basis! (As a result, it's been way too tougher than we'd thought...)

Once we set a goal "Update every day", we, the developer team, became more united than ever we've done. The goal has been encouraging us to make the game fun and enjoyable. It's been really tough but very rewarding at the same time!

"What do we update today?"
↓
"It could be the bug fix of this thing..."
↓
"Will it really satisfy players? We need to keep working on this part to get it released in today's patch, don't we?"

We've kept those conversations going. That's why we could maintain our passions and motivations to update, and to evolve Overdungeon!

The daily update has been one of the features Overdungeon has, however, it's been 100 days and we think it could be a milestone for us. We discussed if we'd continue the daily update. And we're considering to stop this for these 3 reasons.

■ 1. The Daily Update Costs Us So Much
To achieve the daily update, we're required to do things below every day.
a. Discussion on update
b. Development of contents
c. Contents translation(Japanese => English, Japanese => Chinese)
d. Patch notes writing
e. Patch notes translation(Japanese => English, Japanese => Chinese)
f. Development testing
g. Release

C, d, e, and f has cost non-negligible amount of time for a while. Especially f, development testing should be automated to maintain the quality of Overdungeon right now. (Now we have 3 characters, Lilith, Sugar, and Valley. We need to test the triple amount of contents!!)
We actually are working on test automation, yet we are a small developer team. We want to prioritize improving and developing new contents over the daily update. The more contents we have in the game, the harder it gets to achieve the daily update.

■ 2. Duration of the Daily Update Is Enough to Apply for Guinness World Records
We are going to apply for Guinness World Records to certify Overdungeon as "The game with the longest duration of daily update". We believe that Consecutive 100 days are sufficient to apply for the record.
There are other "Daily ~~~ records" except daily gaming stuff, however, it's all depending on Guinness World Records whether Overdungeon would be listed is the Guinness Book of World Records.
If we fail, we continue updating Overdungeon to apply for "The most updated game of the world"!

■ 3. Not All Players Want the Daily Update
We've noticed not all the players want the daily update. Some want to have sophisticated updates instead of daily updates. As a matter of fact, we've been faced with these difficulties.

a. Daily update costs so much! (If we stop daily updates, we could develop more contents)
b. The number of tests is decreased and the number of releases is increased. This causes the unnoticeable bugs. (If we stop daily updates, we could prevent the bugs from appearing in a production environment!)
c. Daily update exhausts us! (Harder than we thought at first!)
d. Players should download hundreds of MB data every day.
e. It's not easy to read Release notes every day.

It's obvious that the daily update is a thing for the players who play Overdungeon every day. Overdungeon is in Early Access right now, so everything in the game is subject to change, and we seriously want to update to make it better. We've kept updating daily but it should be reconsidered and changed if it's not the best way to do. We find it difficult to make it the best for every single player. We sought the way to maximize the goodness, the duration between releases is optimally once a week or a few times a month like other game studios do!

Anyway, we decided to stop the daily update. However, we might start it again as if we're back to "Every day is Friday" days, or we might release as soon as we come up with the new contents! We, the developer team, love Overdungeon so much! We strongly believe that Overdungeon becomes one of the greatest game! Hope you'll have fun and stay tuned with us!
